svg.title: One shortcut. Your desk again.
svg.desc: A Windows PC is lending its monitor to a MacBook Pro. Ctrl + Alt + 3 shows the Windows desktop; pressing it again restores the same Mac desktop. The added screens and connection stay open. While the PC shows its own desktop, its keyboard and mouse stay with it.
svg.text: Switch lent monitors between this computer and the other one.

g.text: The other computer’s desktop, right where you left it.
Your keyboard and mouse stay with this computer.

svg.text: Screens must already be lent. Change the keys in Settings → Shortcuts.
